title: Affine basis coordinates for a prescribed-point smooth Bertini system
statement: Let $k$ be algebraically closed, $X$ a connected affine smooth finite-type $k$-scheme of pure dimension $d\ge 2$, and $S\subset X$ a nonempty finite set of closed points. There exist the open $U_0=X\setminus S$, an invertible module $L$ on $X$, an integer $r$, and an additive map $\psi:k^r\to\Gamma(X,L)$ compatible with the canonical $k$-scalar action, such that every section $\psi(a)$ vanishes on $S$, the basis sections generate $L$ on $U_0$ and induce an immersion there, and a nonempty open $O\subset\operatorname{Spec}(k[t_1,\ldots,t_r])$ whose rational coefficient members $Z(\psi(a))$ are affine, smooth and pure of dimension $d-1$. No cover, irreducibility of a member or point-factorization conclusion is asserted. Scheme and morphism conventions are [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]; invertible modules, generating sections, projective morphisms, zero schemes and pure dimension are [def-sc-invertible-module], [def-weil-pbc-generating-sections], [def-weil-pbc-morphism-to-projective-space-by-sections], [def-pc-zero-scheme], [def-weil-pure-dimension].

proof.text: The private exists_projective_chart proves the compactification step. Smooth connected finite-type X is regular, locally Noetherian and integral. Present Γ(X,O_X) as a quotient of a finite polynomial algebra, adjoin a homogenizing coordinate, and apply the proved source theorem Proj.exists_isClosedImmersion_chart to these generators. Its chart isomorphism gives an open immersion j from X, its generic point proves density, and its chart equation proves that the composite structure map is the original one. No new compactification existence statement is assumed.

Apply exists_eventual_prescribedPoint_smoothSystem to this projective chart and choose n equal to the bound. Set M=O_Y(n), L=j^*M, r=card I and enumerate the finite kernel basis by e:I≃Fin r. Define ψ(a) as the actual tensor-pullback unit of the sum of a(e(i))s_i. The unit is additive and semilinear: its inverse-image-of-top restriction is the identity and its adjunction unit is a module morphism. This proves the scalar clause using j followed by the ambient structure map equal to the original structure map.

Uniqueness of the coefficient representation of zero makes the combination map injective, by subtracting two tuples. Every coefficient tuple therefore represents a section in the vanishing kernel. The nonvanishing-locus versus zero-support equality converts its residue-fibre vanishing to containment of S in the actual zero scheme.

A basis vector maps under ψ to the corresponding restricted basis section. The proved private tensorUnit_comp identifies iterated restriction with restriction along the composite, by the normalized adjunction-unit equation. Use the inverse tensorSectionsComp module isomorphism and the equivalence ULift(Fin r)≃I in the general generatingSections_immersion_iso_reindex theorem. This supplies exactly the generating epimorphism and the projective immersion required on U=X minus S.

Use the polynomial-ring equivalence induced by e and pull back the smooth-member open along its Spec isomorphism. Surjectivity preserves nonemptiness. Evaluation after polynomial renaming is evaluation at the reindexed tuple. Thus the given rational point lies in the old open, and its old member is definitionally the zero scheme of ψ(a). Transfer smoothness, affineness and pure dimension directly from hmembers.

proof_origin.place: Paragraph 2; concrete source-library projective chart, restriction via adjunction units, and finite basis reindexing. The sole new hole is invariance of an immersive generating family under module isomorphism and index equivalence.

theorem exists_smooth_affine_prescribedPoint_linearSystem
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [IsAffine X] [ConnectedSpace X]
    [Smooth (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hdim : X.IsPureDimension d)
    (S : Finset X) (hS : S.Nonempty) (hclosed : ∀ x ∈ S, IsClosed ({x} : Set X)) :
    ∃ (U₀ : X.Opens), (U₀ : Set X) = (S : Set X)ᶜ ∧
    ∃ (L : X.Modules) (_ : L.IsInvertible) (r : ℕ) (ψ : (Fin r → k) →+ Γ(L, ⊤)),
      (∀ (c : k) (v : Fin r → k),
        ψ (c • v) = (X ↘ Spec (.of k)).appTop ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv c) • ψ v) ∧
      (∀ (v : Fin r → k) (x : X), x ∈ S →
        x ∈ (homOfGlobalSection L (ψ v)).zeroLocus.support) ∧
      ∃ hgen : Epi (((tensorPullback U₀.ι).obj L).freeHomEquiv.symm
        (fun i : ULift.{u} (Fin r) ↦ SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv _
          (homOfGlobalSection _ (tensorSectionsUnit U₀.ι L (ψ (Pi.basisFun k (Fin r) i.down)))))),
        IsImmersion (@ProjectiveSpace.homOfGeneratingSections
          (ULift.{u} (Fin r)) inferInstance U₀.toScheme (Spec (.of k))
          (U₀.ι ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k))) ((tensorPullback U₀.ι).obj L)
          (Scheme.Modules.IsInvertible.of_iso
            (((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction U₀.ι)).leftAdjointUniq
              (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction U₀.ι)).app L).symm)
          (fun i : ULift.{u} (Fin r) ↦ SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv _
            (homOfGlobalSection _
              (tensorSectionsUnit U₀.ι L (ψ (Pi.basisFun k (Fin r) i.down))))) hgen) ∧
        ∃ O : (Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin r) k))).Opens,
          (O : Set (Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin r) k)))).Nonempty ∧
          ∀ a : Fin r → k,
            Set.range (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (RingHom.id k) a))) ⊆
              (O : Set _) →
            Smooth ((homOfGlobalSection L (ψ a)).zeroLocus.subschemeι ≫
              (X ↘ Spec (.of k))) ∧
            IsAffine (homOfGlobalSection L (ψ a)).zeroLocus.subscheme ∧
            (homOfGlobalSection L (ψ a)).zeroLocus.subscheme.IsPureDimension (d - 1)
